business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cold-Chain Keg Wholesale and Export of Artisanal Hazy IPAs

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus, in force 2020) – trade and investment facilitation
WTO Membership – bound goods and services schedules
EU–OACPS Samoa Agreement (2023) – development collaboration and trade preferences
Double Taxation Agreement with New Zealand – limited treaty network; tax information exchange arrangements with Australia and New Zealand active

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 2014 (No. 20 of 2014), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2017 and 2020, particularly sections on register of beneficial owners and registered agent due diligence; Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act 2020; Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2014; Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2021; SIFA AML/CFT Guidelines and UBO Filing Rules issued under the International Companies Act; FATF Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering mutual evaluation obligations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of each natural-person UBO's passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority of the UBO's country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Samoa acceded effective 7 March 2019); Consular Legalization required if the issuing state is not a Hague Convention member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement) for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or financial institution of the UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by licensed notary plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate register excerpt (certificate of incorporation and current directors/shareholders register) for any corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the corporate UBO's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Registry certification plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming identity and expected transaction profile of each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank holding the UBO's primary account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Direct bank-to-agent correspondence accepted for AML purposes; apostille not required if transmitted directly by the bank; letterhead and authorized signatory verification mandatory

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance certificate (or negative media declaration) for directors and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Criminal records authority of the UBO's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Executed UBO statutory declaration and structure chart (Form UBO-1)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Samoa licensed registered agent in the presence of a Samoa notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No consular path required for documents executed in Samoa; retained by the registered agent and SIFA

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory onboarding screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Database, UK HMT Sanctions List, and SIFA domestic Specified Entities and Listed Persons Register; PEP status determination at onboarding and continuous re-screening on a rolling 90-day cycle for at least 12 months post-incorporation; Enhanced Due Diligence triggered for PEPs, family members, and close associates, including source-of-wealth review for any beneficial interest above 10%; negative news checks via World-Check, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, or equivalent commercial database; all results documented in a non-public client risk file with retention of at least 5 years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) e-Registry Portal (SIFADirect Online Services); for domestic parallel registration reference: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) Business Registry Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory company name must be recorded in Roman/Latin script in English; a Chinese or other script name may be adopted as an additional parallel name in the Articles of Association but must be accompanied by a romanized transliteration (pinyin or equivalent) and cannot appear as the sole statutory name; all registration certificates, formal correspondence, and customs/keg-export documentation must display the English statutory name; names containing non-Latin characters are rejected at submission without substantive review.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Fund / Mutual Fund / Collective Investment Scheme
Government / State / Crown / Ministry / Authority / Municipal
Royal / University / Institute / Chamber of Commerce
Limited / Ltd / Corporation / Inc must appear as the last token and cannot be used as a standalone prohibited term
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a proposed name contains a prohibited or sensitive token, the applicant must obtain prior written consent from the Minister responsible for the SIFA or the sector supervisor before re-submission; upon formal rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 working days of the rejection notice, setting out the grounds for distinctiveness and any supporting consent; the Registrar must issue a decision within 10 working days; a further appeal lies to the Supreme Court of Samoa on a question of law; name reservation fees are non-refundable except where rejection resulted from an evident registry error, in which case a re-submission within the original 30-day window is made at no additional cost; a fresh reservation application and fee are required after the 30-day validity window expires.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for the statutory registered office. Every Samoa International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Samoa located at the premises of a licensed SIFA-registered agent; virtual office arrangements may only be used as supplemental communications or mail-forwarding services and cannot satisfy the statutory requirement; for the craft beer cold-chain distribution scope, the registered agent must also be appointed as the company's authorized representative for service of process and AML/CFT obligations; the company is not subject to a heavy local economic substance test provided business operations, warehouse assets, and management decisions remain outside Samoa, but if cold-chain assets (refrigerated storage or keg fleet) are later attributed to the Samoa entity, the SIFA substance filing obligations will increase.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — approximately 5% annual probability for a low-risk wholesale distribution International Company without local physical assets; probability rises to approximately 20% if temperature-controlled logistics assets or a local distribution branch are registered in Samoa; SIFA and the Financial Intelligence Unit conduct joint unannounced inspections primarily on higher-risk sectors and document-heavy nominee arrangements; compliance with the registered agent's AML/KYC file and timely UBO register updates materially reduces inspection triggers.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 2008 (Samoa), as amended — International Company (IC) incorporation provisions, comprising application for registration, execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association, issue of Certificate of Incorporation, registered office and registered agent requirements, and first board governance rules
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies Office, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Government of Samoa, Apia
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 — Application for Registration as an International Company, together with the notarially executed Memorandum and Articles of Association and consents to act
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up or authorized capital; the International Company may be incorporated with zero issued capital. No escrow account or statutory capital deposit is required under Samoan law; shares may be issued as fully paid or partly paid at par and are exempt from capital duty
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — [Company Name] International Company

RESOLVED: The subscriber, having executed the Memorandum and Articles of Association, hereby subscribes for and accepts the allotment of one ordinary share of no par value, fully paid, subject to no further calls.

RESOLVED: The registered office of the Company is fixed at the premises of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa, such office being the Company's statutory address for service of process, and the Secretary shall file formal notice with the Registrar.

RESOLVED: [Director Name] is appointed sole Director, President, and Secretary, with full authority to open and operate bank accounts, execute commercial agreements, and issue the corresponding share certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Office, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa (in-person window or licensed registered agent portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application for the proposed International Company name, ensuring no identical or confusingly similar name is registered in Samoa. Obtain a 30-day priority reservation. The name must end with the word 'Limited' or its approved abbreviation and must not be misleading as to the company's activities.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Certified passport copy of the applicant/subscriber
Letter of consent from the proposed licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or challenged by a similar-name objection, file an alternative name within the reservation window. A written objection may be cured by obtaining a consent letter from the prior registered holder or by changing the distinctive element of the proposed name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public in Samoa or in the jurisdiction of execution; licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, incorporating the registered office clause, share capital clause, director powers, and object clause for craft beer wholesale and distribution. The subscriber must execute the constitution before a notary. Obtain certified copies of directors' passports and signed consents to act.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Notarized execution page of the subscriber
Certified passport copies of subscribers and directors
Consent to act as director (Form 3)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries the constitution, file a correcting amendment or a revised execution page. Notarial defects are cured by re-execution and, where required, apostille/certification from the issuing jurisdiction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of incorporation application with the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies Office, MCIL, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 1 (Application for Registration as an International Company) together with the notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association, consents to act of directors, and the registered agent's written consent. Submit the prescribed filing fee by bank draft or electronic transfer and obtain an official receipt.
required_dossiers: Form 1 application
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act as director(s) (Form 3)
Registered agent's consent and engagement letter
Proof of payment of the registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is requisitioned or rejected, respond in writing within 14 days addressing the stated grounds. Any fee shortfall must be topped up before registration can proceed; a fresh application may be filed if the original lapses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of statutory fees and issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies Office, MCIL, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review of the application, the Registrar enters the company in the International Companies Register and issues the Certificate of Incorporation. Verify the registered company number, exact corporate name, date of incorporation, and the fact that liability is limited by shares.
required_dossiers: Approved Form 1 and constitutive documents
Official receipt of the registration fee
Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains typographical errors, apply for an administrative rectification under the Companies Act 2008. A lost or damaged certificate may be replaced upon submission of an affidavit of loss and payment of the replacement fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notification of registered office and licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies Office, MCIL, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the statutory notice confirming the registered office in Samoa maintained by the licensed registered agent. The office must be a physical address open for service of process during business hours. Update the register of agents and office holders accordingly.
required_dossiers: Statutory notice of registered office and registered agent (Form 5)
Registered agent authorization letter
Confirmation of the registered office physical address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent is disqualified or the office address is invalid, appoint a replacement licensed agent and file an amended notice within the statutory period (normally 14 days) to maintain good standing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board governance activation and bank readiness
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass the pro-forma first board resolution in writing. Adopt the registered office, subscribe and allot the initial share, appoint officers, issue the share certificate, and approve the banking resolution for opening a corporate account for keg wholesale and export settlement.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma first board resolution
Share certificate counterfoil and register of members
Bank account opening documentation and beneficial ownership declaration
Register of directors and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any defective act of the first board meeting may be ratified by a subsequent written resolution of the board. If the sole director resigns, the shareholder shall appoint a successor by written consent to maintain quorum and continuity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Liquor Licensing Authority, Ministry of Customs and Revenue (MCR), Samoa; general business registration through the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Liquor Manufacturer's/Wholesale License under the Liquor Act 2011 (Samoa), together with Food Business Operator Registration under the Samoa Food Act 2022 for the craft beer distribution facility

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Development Consent with Preliminary Environmental Assessment; a Full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Report is mandated for brewery operations producing more than 100 m³ per day of trade wastewater or located within a groundwater protection zone or coastal catchment area
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Samoa Water Quality Standards: Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) ≤ 20 mg/L, Total Suspended Solids (TSS) ≤ 30 mg/L, pH 6.5–8.5; pre-treatment of brewery trade waste prior to sewer discharge; control of VOC/odor emissions from fermentation, kegging, and packaging operations; spent grain, yeast, and solid waste handling under the Waste Management Act 2010 through reuse, composting, or licensed disposal

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA), including inspection of keg storage, refrigerated warehousing, and filling areas; structural load inspection certificate from the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure (MWTI); occupational safety and health clearance under the Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013 covering cold-chain handling, forklift operation, manual handling, and mandatory PPE protocols

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue of Samoa (MOR), National Taxpayer Services, https://www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Samoa International Company (IC) obtains statutory tax identity by filing the prescribed Incorporation Application with the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) and registering the IC with the Ministry of Revenue through Form TIN-01. Where the IC engages in a taxable activity (importation, local supply, or export), the IC must also obtain a VAGST registration number by filing Form VAGST-01 and the accompanying supporting documents; for pure offshore exempt business, the IC may obtain a Tax Exemption Certificate instead of an active income-tax TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa law does not apply a US-style check-the-box election. The IC enjoys automatic statutory tax exemption under the International Companies Act 2014 for non-resident-source income and maintains that exemption by complying with the annual license fee regime. For indirect tax purposes, an IC may elect to voluntarily register for VAGST to claim input credits on export-related costs; no hybrid mismatch elective mechanism is relevant because the entity is treated as tax-transparent in its home jurisdiction only if such treatment is established by the foreign corporate law and recognised under Samoa tax law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 annual taxable turnover; voluntary registration permitted for exporters below the threshold to recover input VAT on production and distribution costs
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not currently mandate real-time fiscal electronic invoicing or digital tax stamping for beer exports. Businesses must issue compliant VAGST tax invoices and export documentation, and all export declarations are processed through the Samoa Customs Service using the ASYCUDA World electronic single-window system, which serves as the de facto clearance and audit trail.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods such as craft beer and cold-chain keg inventory qualify for VAGST zero-rating when the supplier exports the goods from Samoa within 28 days of supply, retains evidence of physical export, and supplies the goods under a contract with a non-resident recipient. Direct offshore services and ancillary international distribution services supplied to non-residents for use wholly outside Samoa also qualify for zero-rating where the recipient is outside Samoa and the services are not supplied to a person in Samoa for consumption in Samoa.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration filed through ASYCUDA World
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure from Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT credit advice evidencing foreign-currency payment repatriation
Original VAGST tax invoice and zero-rating certification
Certificate of Origin (Form A or non-preferential Samoa origin certificate, as applicable)
Cold-chain transport temperature logs for keg beer, where required by Samoa Customs or the destination market regulator
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Samoa Customs and the Ministry of Revenue may retrospectively deny zero-rating and claw back VAGST refunds plus statutory late payment interest where export evidence is incomplete, untimely, or fraudulent. Knowingly providing false export declarations or fabricated freight documentation attracts civil penalties of up to 200% of the tax shortfall, criminal fines up to WST 100,000, imprisonment of up to 7 years, and loss of the IC's statutory tax exemption status if the offending activity taints the offshore character of the company.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS; Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa), administering the Exchange Control Act 1975, the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984, and the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 together with reserve bank directives for authorized foreign-exchange dealers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Samoa applies a managed exchange-rate framework with statutory exchange control. Current-account convertibility is broadly available: import/export payments, distribution fees, freight, insurance and trade settlement are processed by authorized dealers against commercial documents and bank reference checks, aligning with Samoa's Article VIII obligations with the IMF. The Samoan Tala (WST) is non-deliverable offshore; all conversion must occur through an onshore authorized dealer. Capital-account convertibility is selective: resident entities require CBS licensing for external borrowings and outbound remittances above WST 500,000-equivalent. A non-resident International Company (WS_IC) is carved out of the exchange-control perimeter where it maintains exclusively foreign-currency accounts and has no dealing in Samoan Tala; profit remittance and distribution to settlor/trust beneficiaries are then documentary rather than license-intensive, subject only to the depository bank's anti-money-laundering verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For resident exporters, CBS directions require collection of export proceeds through an authorized dealer within 90 days of shipment and surrender of 100% of the foreign-exchange value into WST unless a foreign-currency retention permit has been granted for up to 50% working-capital cover. For the Samoa IC operating as a non-resident craft-beer wholesaler, export receipts from sales of cold-chain kegs outside Samoa are outside the surrender perimeter and may remain in USD in the IC's operational account. Where the IC is the actual Samoan exporter of record for customs purposes, receipts must still route through a licensed dealer with the export licence, bill of lading, and brewery invoice; only the resident cost portion is subject to mandatory WST conversion and CBS reporting.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD demand deposit with WST trade-settlement sub-ledger) plus USD Capital Escrow designation for inbound trust capital
Capital Escrow Account for the WS_IC capitalisation and cold-chain equipment financing (state-owned development bank window)
Operational Account (USD wholesale distribution and local direct-debit clearing for Apia cold-chain premises)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium with material legal constraints. Samoa does not operate an e-money or payment-institution licence category, and a Samoa International Company may not itself hold itself out as a payment service provider. Cross-border digital EMIs (Wise Business, Airwallex, Currencycloud-type MSB rails) generally maintain Banking Act 2005-licensed counterparties outside Samoa and commonly apply exclusion lists covering Pacific offshore jurisdictions; they also require a funded inbound SWIFT transfer from a licensed Samoa bank, which duplicates the clearing chain and introduces depository uncertainty for the correspondent. Recommended construct: keep the licensed Samoa bank as the account-holder of record and use the fintech EMI only as a discrete USD pay-in/payout rail for refunds to distributors, never as the primary treasury hub.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 and CBS know-your-customer directives mandate verified identity of all signatories, directors and beneficial owners, but do not statutorily require physical board appearance at a Samoan branch. ANZ and BSP permit remote audio-visual onboarding for a Low_Risk_Standard trade entity, provided the Samoan licensed registered agent attests the corporate file, passport copies are notarised or certified by the issuing government, and the trust's UBO schedule accompanies the account opening. Bank of Samoa applies a stricter protocol and generally requires at least one authorized signatory to complete an in-person interview at the Apia headquarters; a written waiver may be issued where the economic-substance dossier demonstrates active cold-chain premises.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore family-trust overlay with PRC/HK settlor origins and nominee directors obscures ultimate beneficial ownership from the bank's CBS screening.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified trust deed and family constitution; CBS-format UBO schedule naming every trustee and protector; certificate of incumbency issued by the Samoan licensed registered agent; source-of-wealth memorandum tracing the settlor's accumulation through beverage wholesale and distribution; signed CPA provenance letter; notarised English translations of Chinese-language instruments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Alcohol-industry trade-scope red flag: craft-beer wholesale on ISIC 4632 triggers excise, liquor-licensing and correspondent-bank reputational screening for the distributor's hazy IPA portfolio.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour wholesale liquor licence; brewery supply and offtake agreements with named artisanal breweries; batch-level cold-chain keg tracking and despatch records; quarantine and food-safety export certificates; commercial invoice set; certificate of origin; three-way matching purchase order, invoice and delivery dossier.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capitalisation narrative mismatch: the initial shareholder loan or escrow injection arrives from a Hong Kong family-trust account rather than from the brewery group's operating treasury, prompting enhanced due diligence on the source of funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital injection board resolution; issued share register and share-transfer ledgers; escrow instruction letter; the trust's banker's reference and three-month statements evidencing the distribution leg; the IC's good-standing certificate from the Samoa Registry; economic-substance dossier showing the Apia cold-chain facility and distribution management records.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Recommended compliant routing: settlor/trust treasury in Hong Kong or Singapore executes a SWIFT MT103 customer transfer to the WS_IC's USD demand-deposit account at ANZ Bank (Samoa) Limited in Apia; if the value date exceeds USD 250,000, the sending bank should pre-advise with a bank reference confirming the underlying trust distribution. The transfer narrative must state 'International Company capital contribution — family trust distribution' and carry BPM6 purpose code 3100 (equity injection) for share capital, or 3900 (other investment — shareholder loan) for debt funding. Funds retained in USD are outside the CBS exchange-control perimeter; if converted to WST for local cold-chain payroll, the authorized dealer records a foreign-exchange declaration at the counter. Verification relies on the account-opening KYC file, the issued-share register, the capitalisation board resolution and the banker's reference from the remitting trust.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for hop, malt, keg and refrigerated container purchases should run over SWIFT MT103 customer transfers from the authorized Samoan dealer (ANZ or BSP) to the supplier's EU/US account; for contracts above USD 250,000 prefer an irrevocable commercial letter of credit issued under UCP600, at sight or 90 days usance, with required documents comprising commercial invoice, cold-chain bill of lading or air waybill, brewery health and phytosanitary certificates, insurance certificate and certificate of origin. Local direct-debit rails are used solely for Apia cold-chain utilities, warehouse rent and quarantine fees; cross-border disbursements must never be delegated to unlicensed money transmitters or cash couriers. The exporting IC must retain the CBS export dossier (delivery notes, export licence, customs declaration) for the authorized dealer's periodic reporting.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forwards — outright USD/WST forward contracts with an authorized dealer, tenor capped at 12 months and strictly supported by an export sales contract or purchase order (CBS trade-backing rule).

NDFs — non-deliverable forwards referencing the Samoan Tala are not permissible under Samoa exchange control; there is no onshore NDF market and offshore WST NDFs are treated as prohibited speculative rings.

Currency swaps — cross-currency USD/EUR and USD/GBP swaps arranged through an authorized dealer's international treasury desk with CBS notification are permissible for cold-chain import/export working capital; WST cross-currency swaps are not offered onshore.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Fee and Company Status Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of incorporation; 30-day grace period permitted
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of USD 50 plus 10% per month on unpaid fee; continued default may lead to administrative strike-off after 90 days from final notice

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and Register Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa MCIL
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the fiscal year end (31 December) or upon any change in shareholding
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance penalty up to USD 500; false statements may incur criminal fine and disqualification of directors

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit for International Companies unless the Registrar/regulator so directs, the company is licensed under the International Financial Services Commission Act, or the company carries on business with Samoan domestic residents
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or a simplified accounting basis acceptable under the International Companies Act 1987; records must accurately explain transactions and financial position

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: International Company must file with the Registrar a confirmation of beneficial ownership details annually within 30 days of fiscal year end; any transfer of shares reflecting a change in shareholder or beneficial owner must be recorded and filed within 14 days, followed by an annual confirmation

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 (no statutory audit); voluntary audit/review USD 500 - USD 1,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% for resident companies; 0% for an International Company (IC) in the tax-exempt zone
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Samoa International Companies Act 1987 grants total income-tax exemption on foreign-source income and all international business transactions; no capital gains tax, no payroll tax, and no minimum local capital requirement for an IC

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC Annual Return – Form 3 under Samoa International Companies Act 1987 (filed through the Samoa Companies Registry online portal; income tax return not required for exempt IC)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing due within 90 days after each incorporation anniversary date

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name, IC registration number, registered office and Samoa-chartered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name and registration number from the Certificate of Incorporation; no Samoan tax reference number required because the IC is tax-exempt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current register of directors and shareholders, with nationalities and addresses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List all non-resident officers and shareholders; no tax residency certificate asked by the Registrar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not engaged in any domestic Samoan trade or holding of Samoan land
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm that the business is exclusively international; this declaration preserves the tax-exempt status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual-return filing triggers a WST 500 late fee plus WST 50 per day; continued default leads to administrative strike-off, forfeiture of assets, and perpetual director disqualification without court order.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for tax-exempt International Companies; standard Samoa resident company dividend WHT is 15% (if tax-exempt status is revoked)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa has very limited DTA coverage; for any applicable treaty, a non-resident claimant must submit (i) a certified Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the home tax authority, (ii) a Samoa RWT exemption declaration (Form RWT/WHT-Ex), and (iii) beneficial-ownership affidavit to the paying IC or its Samoa agent before the payment date; tax-exempt ICs require no relief because no WHT arises.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Samoan rates are 15% for royalties and 15% for interest paid to non-residents; for tax-exempt ICs receiving foreign-source royalty/interest, the effective rate is 0%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No Samoa-code threshold for ICs; commercial benchmark aligns with OECD local file / master file when related-party transactions exceed WST 2,000,000 in a year.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations. An IC must maintain a registered office and locally licensed registered agent in Samoa, but no genuine economic activity requirement or staff/expenditure ratios apply; this makes the IC an acceptable low-risk holding/distribution vehicle only when no domestic Samoan trade occurs.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC to conceal taxable income in Samoa or abroad, or filing false annual return declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off of the IC, forfeiture of property by the Registrar, and financial penalties of up to WST 100,000
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors become personally liable for unpaid taxes and penalties; court-ordered travel bans and imprisonment for up to 7 years apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Misuse / Domestic Trade Abroad
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting a Samoan domestic trade (e.g., distributing craft beer within Samoa) while claiming tax-exempt IC status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of the IC tax exemption, retroactive corporate income tax at 27% on all domestic-source profits, and 150% surcharge on the tax shortfall
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing of the corporate veil: joint and several civil liability for the full tax arrears, director disqualification, and potential custodial sentence for fraudulent trading.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting deposit or transfer of craft-beer distribution proceeds without performing customer due diligence under the Samoa AML/CFT Act 2007
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil penalty of up to WST 1,000,000, regulatory suspension of the IC, and cancellation of the agent's license
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face criminal fines, forfeiture of unlawful gains, and imprisonment of up to 10 years for knowing money-laundering facilitation.
